relations.name: Preserved Lemon Couscous
relations.rationale: The brightness of preserved lemon complements the warm spices in Ras el Hanout, making for a harmonious dish.

relations.name: Berbere
relations.rationale: Berbere is another North African spice blend that shares some similar spices, making it a logical base for dishes that can also incorporate Ras el Hanout.

relations.name: Vegetable and Beef Skillet
relations.rationale: The hearty flavors of the vegetable and beef skillet can be enhanced by the complex spices in Ras el Hanout.

relations.name: Harissa
relations.rationale: Harissa, a spicy North African sauce, pairs well with the warm flavors of Ras el Hanout, enhancing the overall dish.
